block_verification.method: Exact unique ID/full attribute/geometry comparison with current independently stamped network.pickle.

quantization_limits.round_cap_method: Analytic stencil limits and true primary same-width joins; rare rounded-ring degeneracy must exactly match independently quantized SVG rings.

symbol_independent_readback.review_boundary: Fresh v8 exports are audited directly. No geometry invariance or inherited full-city audit is assumed. Every symbol polygon and actual neighbouring public primitive is independently rebuilt, including primary joint and free endpoint flags. Not road engineering or aesthetic acceptance.

strict_public_graph.scope: actual public centreline primitives; multipart pieces do not automatically connect

actual_classification.basis: v8 restored port branch; actual rural crossing

limitations: The 160m deck is a map symbol approach range, not certified bridge span or engineered structure.
This audit certifies actual exported crossing geometry and drawing order; final PNG observation is separately recorded.
Street-block centreline faces retain their exact pregap land geometry; the new drybank road reservation occupies only their edge setback and is not a new interior subdivision.
34m conceptual road plus11m setback gives28m half reservation; the actual120m water-centreline bridge is not certified structural span.

road_endpoints.classifier_scope: Raw staged checker lists all open named ends; final decision is the explicit purpose review, not an all-arbitrary-ends pass.

adjudications.name: 云麓公路
adjudications.observed_evidence: 实际近景中这条窄路抵达博物馆前庭，馆区位于山地边缘；馆场地和院内步道距末端约16m，馆屋顶约89m。
adjudications.scope_limit: 馆内步道保持设施层；最后16m铺装连接和车辆回转细部需在手工POI阶段完成。

adjudications.name: 窑湾旧道
adjudications.observed_evidence: 实际近景中末端位于村落场地，真实村道距离0m、最近村屋约50m，可沿村道继续进入居民地。
adjudications.scope_limit: 村道保持村落设施层，不冒充公共城市干支路。

adjudications.name: 东岭山前路
adjudications.purpose: 东岭郊区工厂及农田服务支路
adjudications.observed_evidence: 实际近景可见末段服务工厂院区、随后抵达农田边缘；最近现存组团入口约48m、厂屋约80m。
adjudications.scope_limit: 这是郊区服务道路的末段；厂门、停车和回转设施细化仍待POI阶段，未宣称主干骨架端点。

adjudications.name: 南郊连接路
adjudications.purpose: 南郊仓储及农田服务支路
adjudications.observed_evidence: 实际近景显示道路经过现存仓储组团入口后终止在田块边缘；最近入口约94m、仓库屋顶约149m。
adjudications.scope_limit: 窄乡野服务路允许保留末端；回转与场地细节尚未完成。

adjudications.name: 机场北郊路
adjudications.observed_evidence: 实际近景显示道路末端接本组团入口，真实入口距离0m；最近住宅屋顶约49m。
adjudications.scope_limit: 内部通道仍属本组团私有路径，不提升为公共街道。

known_port_service_end.name: 南港出城国道
known_port_service_end.basis: root identifies existing port-yard service-road destination; not a random public-street stub

verification_limits: Facade entrances are algorithm-selected positions, not authored architectural doors.
Private compound geometry and ownership checks do not certify road/rail curve radius, slope, traffic capacity or timetable capacity.
Named station/campus/museum paths, village and farm tracks without lot ownership remain a separate facilities layer; their crossing candidates are recorded, not certified as grade-separated.
Boundary stroke/cap contacts are distinct from a private centreline traversing another owner interior; this is not parcel-law certification.
Inherited minor service road destinations are individually recorded; main-road same-or-higher terminal hierarchy was not uniformly required by the generator.
Technical passing and actual image review do not mean all visual refinement complete or user adoption.
Street-block IDs, all exported attributes and geometries were compared against the current independently hash-frozen network cache; this is a fresh v8 audit, without inherited geometry passing.
District planning and disaster recovery are design proposals; canon was not rewritten.
